Definition: Shomer, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shomer is the name of two Israelites, and the two lives could hardly be more different. One was a son of Heber, an Asherite, whose sister was Shua, and the other was the father of Jehozabad, one of the servants who struck down King Joash in his own house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name can carry two opposite stories. One Shomer raised a family in Asher, the other raised a murderer, and I hold that God judges each man by his own deeds, not by his name.
